name: sercomm-printserver
description: Manage, configure and print to SerComm network print servers (Sercom PS301 and its TRENDnet, Perle, Netgear and Linksys twins) from Claude Code. Ships the sercomm-printserver skill: find devices, read status and configuration, change settings safely, restart, print by LPD or RAW, and recover a device whose address or password is lost.
